warranty.notes: 60% of initial usable capacity at 10 years from installation (max. 126 months from manufacture) or the minimum energy throughput, whichever comes first. For batteries installed before 1 October 2024 (purchasers of those may choose V7.1 or V8.0). The warranty doesn't say whether throughput counts charged or discharged energy.
